svg.title: The five jobs of a context engineer
svg.desc: Five hand-drawn cards in a row, each with a numbered badge, naming the five recurring jobs of a context engineer: decide what goes in, decide what stays out, decide where each piece sits, decide when to refresh or compress, and decide how to measure whether it worked. Each card carries a short gloss and a pointer to the post that covers it. A caption reads that doing one of these five is doing context engineering, whatever the job title says.
svg.text: Five jobs of a context engineer
Whatever the application, the day-to-day work decomposes into these five.
Do one of these five and you are doing context engineering, whatever the job title says.
